lines.text: [dramatic, theatrical] The Obedience Ray. One shot, and everyone does exactly what I say.
lines.sub:
The Obedience Ray. One shot, and
everyone does exactly what I say.
lines.plain: The Obedience Ray. One shot, and everyone does exactly what I say.

lines.text: [shouting, triumphant] People of Earth! Kneel before me!
lines.plain: People of Earth! Kneel before me!
lines.sub: People of Earth! Kneel before me!

lines.text: [politely apologetic] Oh, terribly sorry. After you.
[politely insistent] No, no, I insist. After you.
lines.plain: No, no, I insist. After you.
lines.sub: No, no, I insist. After you.

lines.text: [warm, delighted] Of course! Can I get you anything? A cup of tea?
lines.sub:
Of course! Can I get you anything?
A cup of tea?
lines.plain: Of course! Can I get you anything? A cup of tea?

lines.text: [flustered, embarrassed] Stop being nice to me!
[kindly, warm] You're doing a wonderful job, love.
lines.plain: You're doing a wonderful job, love.
lines.sub: You're doing a wonderful job, love.

lines.text: [kindly] About the rent, dear. No rush at all.
lines.sub:
About the rent, dear.
No rush at all.
